findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 385 requests to 100 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 6.9 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.3 MB (48%) came from third-party domains, 2.1 MB of it from services classified as tracking (302 requests).

74 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), agkn.com (Neustar (TransUnion), advertising).
190 cookies were set by third-party domains (225 cookies in total).
